evidence.notes: Named Map<String,Object> bind selects a persisted Account by a nondefault Name value.
Named Map<String,Object> bind returns the exact persisted Account count for a nondefault Name value.

source.content: insert new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Bind Target'), new Account(Name = 'Bind Other')}; Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('wantedName', 'Bind Target'); List<Account> rows = Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wantedName', binds); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals('Bind Target', rows[0].Name); Integer matching = Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :wantedName', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, matching);
